cases.refreshed: Don't just dream of a winter wonderland, create your own. Bring a little snow to San Jose with this hands-on holiday workshop! Combine chemistry and creativity to design your very own winter wonderland in a jar. Build a miniature snowy scene, add your own frosty finishing touches, and discover the science behind the swirling snow. Best of all, you'll take home a one-of-a-kind snow globe to enjoy all season long! Price: $10 members, $15 non-members General Admission not included, but required for entry. Workshop ticket required for anyone entering.

cases.refreshed: Thanksgiving leftovers? We're putting a whole new spin on the holiday feast! Gather your friends and family for a bite-sized culinary adventure, in sphere form! Using the science of molecular gastronomy, your group will transform holiday-inspired flavors into colorful edible spheres that burst with flavor! Mix, experiment, and create a holiday feast that's as much science as it is delicious fun.

cases.refreshed: Reading Buddies provides students in grades K-3 with an opportunity to improve their reading skills by working one-on-one with a reading coach. Reading Buddies creates a positive reading experience for beginning and developing readers and helps children build confidence as readers. Our reading coach will listen to children read and provide support in reading and comprehension. Students can bring their favorite book or choose from the available selection at the Joyce Ellington Branch Library. Free. No advance registration is required. Sessions are available on a first-come, first-served basis. Session length may depend on how many students attend.

cases.refreshed: Storytime is designed to accommodate a mix of ages and invites the entire family to participate in early literacy activities such as stories, songs, rhymes, fingerplays, and movement activities. Storytime is a fun and interactive experience for the whole family that promotes the joys of reading and learning for all ages. After storytime, families are invited to Stay & Play. Until 6:30 pm, the Storytime librarian and special toys will be on the Children's Room floor to keep the fun going. Meet new friends, play with toys, chat, get book recommendations, and maybe even create something! Storytime: 5:30-6:00 PM; Stay & Play: 6:00-6:30 PM. Free, with limited capacity. This program is developed to align with the Early Education Quality Standards.

cases.refreshed: This event was rescheduled from November 22. Join us for the Julia Robinson Math Festival, an event that provides students with fun and meaningful math experiences to develop their mathematical confidence, joy, and problem-solving skills. There will be a variety of play-based, manipulative-based math puzzles and games for students in grades K - 8 and their parents or caregivers. Each activity will be led by at least one trained volunteer who will introduce the activity and keep students engaged and excited as they explore. During the 1-hour festival, kids can explore at their own pace, choosing which activities to try and how long to spend on each. Recommended for ages 5 to 10+. Free. No registration required. This program is brought to you by the San Jose Legacy Youth Foundation.

cases.refreshed: The mission is top secret, but we'll tell you this: it's all about balloon cars! Participants will build and experiment with balloon-powered cars, investigate the physics behind how they work, and apply that knowledge to improve their designs! Through demos, interactive learning, and hands-on challenges, students will practice asking questions, making predictions, testing ideas, and discovering how scientific concepts connect to the world around them. All materials are provided, and participants receive their very own kit to take home and continue exploring. This program is for Kids Ages 8-11 only. Materials provided! We believe that STEM is about understanding why things work and applying that understanding for deeper exploration. Our workshops encourage students to think creatively, experiment freely, and learn through hands-on exploration. Learn more about us here: https://stem-sense.wixsite.com/stem-sense
